genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段
domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。”。请严格按照 `BP33` 的逐句功能骨架（3 步法）与逻辑法则 `L003`（延续链式推进模式（Linear Chain Progression）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.
structural_constraints: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。”。请按 `BP45` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.

domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
structural_constraints: S1 [分论点主题句 Topic Claim]：一句话清晰亮出本段唯一控制中心（[Policy/Factor X] strengthens [Outcome Y] by [Core Mechanism]）。
S2 [因果机制推演 Causal Elaboration]：Explain HOW and WHY：阐明如果没有这层干扰或有了这项机制，认知/经济/技术流程会发生什么具体改变。
S3 [具象微观案例 Concrete Micro-Case]：For instance, when [Specific Group/Industry] [Specific Action], [Measurable/Observable Consequence]（绝不编造假百分比，用具体场景细节说话）。
S4 [反事实对比或扣题升华 Warrant / Link Back]：Thus, [Summary Noun] shifts human effort from [Low-value Routine] toward [High-value Judgment].

target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段
domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Conference_Rebuttal 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT09 (ICLR/NeurIPS 满分审稿回复全文（Author Rebuttal：含置顶全局回复 + 创新性辩护 + 新增基线与消融表）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP45 -> BP46 -> BP47`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.
structural_constraints: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

source_material_or_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
